notes: Most disagreement was phase (general vs during-work for use rules, course-start vs before-course) and unit_stance (restrict vs prohibit vs neutral). Resolved by re-reading the source: conditional or consent-exception rules and limits on kinds of input are restrict; enforcement or explanatory sentences with no position are neutral; rules governing how students or staff use AI are during-work; example citations and sample disclosures in the templates are informs. Type disagreements (P36/P28 style, P49 vs P52, P63 vs P09/P04, P70 vs P56, P77 vs UNCOVERED for ethics values) were settled by the type definitions; the ethics-values unit stays UNCOVERED. The one document-stance disagreement (IT appropriate-use page) resolved to permit. One coder-A unit combining fact-checking and copyright was split into two. Every unit found by one coder only (A: 13, B: 11) was verified in the source and kept. Coder B's tutorial-purpose clause and coder A's instructor-sharing clause are different clauses and were counted as one only-A and one only-B unit, both kept.
